source.title: Common English words chosen for each age group (starter list). Meanings and sentences are original to this project.
source.license: Reference only (the page describes the kind of list this was modelled on). No list was copied: words, meanings and sentences were written for this project and are released with it.

words.meaning: spoke, like when you tell someone something
words.sentence: Mum said it is time for tea.

words.meaning: the past of 'are'
words.sentence: We were at the park all day.

words.meaning: a word for more than one person you are talking about
words.sentence: They went to the shops.

words.meaning: to move toward the person who is speaking
words.sentence: Please come and sit with us.

words.meaning: a few, but not all
words.sentence: I would like some milk.

words.meaning: to move on your feet at a slow pace
words.sentence: We walk to school each day.
words.tip: There is a silent 'l' in the middle.

words.meaning: to say words to someone
words.sentence: Let us talk about your day.
words.tip: There is a silent 'l' in the middle.

words.meaning: to wish to have something
words.sentence: I want a drink of water.

words.meaning: to hand something to someone to keep
words.sentence: Please give me the pencil.

words.meaning: to have your home somewhere
words.sentence: Where do you live?

words.meaning: a little more or less than; on the subject of
words.sentence: The book is about a lost dog.

words.meaning: later than something else
words.sentence: We had a nap after lunch.

words.meaning: to or at a distance from here
words.sentence: The bird flew away.

words.meaning: earlier than something else
words.sentence: Wash your hands before you eat.

words.meaning: to carry something with you to a place
words.sentence: Please bring your book to school.

words.meaning: the form of 'do' used with he, she or it
words.sentence: She does her homework after school.

words.meaning: coming before all the others
words.sentence: I was the first to arrive.

words.meaning: came across something you were looking for
words.sentence: I found my lost sock.

words.meaning: moving toward a place
words.sentence: We are going to the park.

words.meaning: small in size
words.sentence: A little bird sat on the fence.

words.meaning: different from the one you already have
words.sentence: Give me the other pencil.

words.meaning: below something
words.sentence: The cat is under the table.

words.meaning: up to the time when
words.sentence: Wait here until I come back.

words.meaning: together, or having
words.sentence: I played with my friends.

words.meaning: to a high degree; extremely
words.sentence: The soup is very hot.

words.meaning: starting at a place or time
words.sentence: The letter came from my aunt.

words.meaning: only a moment ago, or only
words.sentence: I have just finished my book.

words.meaning: to hold on to something and not give it away
words.sentence: You can keep the pencil.

words.meaning: brightness that lets you see; not heavy
words.sentence: The light came on.

words.meaning: measuring a great distance from end to end
words.sentence: The snake was very long.

words.meaning: a large amount of something
words.sentence: There is not much milk left.

words.meaning: has to; is needed
words.sentence: You must look both ways before crossing.

words.meaning: a word that tells the reason for something
words.sentence: I wore a coat because it was cold.
words.tip: Big Elephants Can Always Understand Small Elephants.

words.meaning: someone you like and enjoy being with
words.sentence: My friend came to play.
words.tip: You find a fri-END at the end.

words.meaning: men, women and children
words.sentence: Many people were at the market.

words.meaning: a place where children go to learn
words.sentence: We learn to read at school.

words.meaning: a word used to say what could happen or what you want
words.sentence: I would like some juice.

words.meaning: a word that says you were able to
words.sentence: I could see the moon last night.

words.meaning: a word that says what is the right thing to do
words.sentence: You should brush your teeth.

words.meaning: one more time
words.sentence: Please read the story again.

words.meaning: every time, without ever stopping
words.sentence: The sun always rises in the morning.

words.meaning: each one of a group
words.sentence: I brush my teeth every day.

words.meaning: a living thing that is not a plant, such as a cat or a fish
words.sentence: A lion is a wild animal.

words.meaning: a boy or man with the same parents as you
words.sentence: My brother is older than me.

words.meaning: a girl or woman with the same parents as you
words.sentence: My sister likes to paint.

words.meaning: a woman who has a child
words.sentence: My mother reads me a story.

words.meaning: a man who has a child
words.sentence: My father drives us to school.

words.meaning: young people; more than one child
words.sentence: The children played in the garden.

words.meaning: the things you wear, like shirts and trousers
words.sentence: I put my clothes in the drawer.

words.meaning: a land with its own name and its own government
words.sentence: France is a country in Europe.

words.meaning: all through a period of time
words.sentence: I fell asleep during the film.

words.meaning: before the usual or expected time
words.sentence: We got up early to see the sunrise.

words.meaning: the planet we live on
words.sentence: The earth goes around the sun.

words.meaning: parents, children and other relatives who live together
words.sentence: My family eats dinner together.

words.meaning: a piece of ground where flowers or vegetables grow
words.sentence: We grow beans in the garden.

words.meaning: to take place
words.sentence: What will happen next in the story?

words.meaning: the early part of the day
words.sentence: I eat breakfast in the morning.

words.meaning: a word or symbol that tells how many
words.sentence: Pick a number from one to ten.

words.meaning: thin sheets you write or draw on
words.sentence: I drew a picture on paper.

words.meaning: a drawing, painting or photo
words.sentence: She drew a picture of her dog.

words.meaning: nice to look at
words.sentence: What a pretty flower!

words.meaning: coming right after the first
words.sentence: I came second in the race.

words.meaning: the part of the body where your arm joins your body
words.sentence: He carried the bag on his shoulder.

words.meaning: not ordinary; very important
words.sentence: Today is a special day.

words.meaning: the season when plants start to grow
words.sentence: Flowers come out in spring.

words.meaning: the warmest season of the year
words.sentence: We swim in summer.

words.meaning: a person who helps you learn at school
words.sentence: My teacher read us a story.

words.meaning: a problem or difficulty
words.sentence: I had trouble finding my keys.

words.meaning: the number after eleven
words.sentence: There are twelve eggs in the box.

words.meaning: what it is like outside: sunny, rainy or windy
words.sentence: The weather is warm today.

words.meaning: a glass opening in a wall that lets in light
words.sentence: I looked out of the window.

words.meaning: the coldest season of the year
words.sentence: It snows in winter.

words.meaning: the whole Earth and everything on it
words.sentence: She wants to travel the world.

words.meaning: to feel afraid that something bad will happen
words.sentence: Do not worry, it will be fine.

words.meaning: very good, making you full of joy
words.sentence: We had a wonderful day at the beach.

words.meaning: to make a high sound by blowing air through your lips
words.sentence: Can you whistle a tune?
words.tip: There is a silent 't' in the middle.

words.meaning: very pretty to look at
words.sentence: The garden looks beautiful in spring.
words.tip: Big Elephants Always Understand Things If Fed Up Lunches.

words.meaning: with each other, not alone
words.sentence: We played together all afternoon.

words.meaning: one more, or a different one
words.sentence: May I have another slice of bread?

words.meaning: had an idea or an opinion in your mind
words.sentence: I thought it would rain today.

words.meaning: as much as you need
words.sentence: We have enough chairs for everyone.

words.meaning: the day before today
words.sentence: We went to the zoo yesterday.

words.meaning: you hold it over your head to stay dry in the rain
words.sentence: Take an umbrella, it might rain.

words.meaning: something that matters a lot
words.sentence: It is important to drink water.

words.meaning: what you say or write when someone asks a question
words.sentence: Do you know the answer?
words.tip: There is a silent 'w' in the middle.

words.meaning: having a lot to do
words.sentence: Dad is busy cooking dinner.

words.meaning: the time of day between lunch and evening
words.sentence: We played outside in the afternoon.

words.meaning: a thin rubber bag you fill with air or gas
words.sentence: The balloon floated away.

words.meaning: a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal
words.sentence: I ride my bicycle to school.

words.meaning: the day each year when you were born
words.sentence: My birthday is in May.

words.meaning: the first meal of the day
words.sentence: I had cereal for breakfast.

words.meaning: carried something with you to a place
words.sentence: She brought a cake to the party.

words.meaning: completely sure
words.sentence: I am certain that I locked the door.

words.meaning: the child of your aunt or uncle
words.sentence: My cousin stayed with us.

words.meaning: someone's girl child
words.sentence: Their daughter is learning to swim.

words.meaning: a huge animal that lived millions of years ago
words.sentence: The museum has a dinosaur skeleton.

words.meaning: the biggest land animal, with a trunk
words.sentence: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk.

words.meaning: the time of day between afternoon and night
words.sentence: We eat dinner in the evening.

words.meaning: making you feel full of interest and energy
words.sentence: It was an exciting game.

words.meaning: a very tall animal with a long neck
words.sentence: The giraffe ate leaves from the tree.

words.meaning: the father of your mother or father
words.sentence: My grandfather tells good stories.

words.meaning: the mother of your mother or father
words.sentence: My grandmother bakes bread.

words.meaning: a place where doctors and nurses look after sick people
words.sentence: She went to the hospital for a check-up.

words.meaning: wanting to eat
words.sentence: I am hungry after the long walk.

words.meaning: the room where food is cooked
words.sentence: Dad is cooking in the kitchen.

words.meaning: to make a happy sound when something is funny
words.sentence: The joke made us laugh.

words.meaning: a very high hill
words.sentence: We climbed the mountain.

words.meaning: a round juicy fruit with a thick skin
words.sentence: I peeled an orange.

words.meaning: making little or no noise
words.sentence: Please be quiet in the library.

words.meaning: to keep something in your mind
words.sentence: Do you remember my phone number?

words.meaning: two slices of bread with food between them
words.sentence: I ate a cheese sandwich.

words.meaning: a tool with two blades used for cutting paper
words.sentence: Cut the paper with scissors.

words.meaning: a group of words that tells a complete idea
words.sentence: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

words.meaning: the part inside your body where food goes after you swallow
words.sentence: My stomach hurts after too many sweets.

words.meaning: unusual or hard to explain
words.sentence: I heard a strange noise.

words.meaning: the day after today
words.sentence: We will visit the zoo tomorrow.

words.meaning: a plant you eat as food, such as a carrot or bean
words.sentence: A carrot is a vegetable.

words.meaning: an exciting or unusual journey or experience
words.sentence: The pirates went on an adventure.

words.meaning: gold, jewels and other valuable things
words.sentence: They dug up the treasure.

words.meaning: the start of something
words.sentence: The beginning of the film was funny.
